desc: Boosts blood clotting so wounds stop bleeding faster, and can trigger an embolism to halt severe bleeding.
effect: Daily anticoagulant lets you force a clot against an embolism / serious blood loss.
Carries a thrombosis risk: Body Test at +1 TN per use.

desc: Tailored nanite microorganisms in the bloodstream that speed natural healing.
effect: L1 0.4 BI / 15,000¥ — heal in 90% normal time.
L2 0.7 BI / 35,000¥ — 70% time, +50% food intake.
L3 1.0 BI / 60,000¥ — 50% time, +100% food intake.

desc: An enhanced-muscle heart that handles strenuous activity better, aiding athletics and endurance.
effect: L1 0.2 BI / 6,000¥ — +1 die to Athletics-based tests.
L2 0.3 BI / 15,000¥ — +2 dice; helps resist cardiac ailments.

desc: Energy-diffusing material grown beneath the skin granting the equivalent of worn armor.
effect: L2 1.0 BI / 60,000¥ — +1 Impact / +1 Ballistic.
L3 1.5 BI / 100,000¥ — +2 Impact / +2 Ballistic; +TN to tactile Perception; incompatible with dermal plating.

desc: Modified glands emit designer pheromones that boost social influence over nearby people.
effect: L1 0.4 BI / 20,000¥ — +1 die to Charisma / Social Skill tests.
L2 0.6 BI / 45,000¥ — +2 dice; +50% effect range.

desc: An implanted gland that floods the body with adrenaline on command for a short combat surge.
effect: L1 1.25 BI / 60,000¥ — +1 Quickness / +1 Strength / +1 Willpower / +2 Reaction.
L2 2.5 BI / 100,000¥ — +2 Quick / +2 Str / +1 Will / +4 Reaction.
Lasts 10-15 turns, then inflicts Stun Drain and fatigue.

desc: An extra gland that raises overall metabolism, lifting several physical attributes at once.
effect: +1 Body, +1 Quickness, +1 Strength, +1 Reaction.
Requires roughly triple normal food/drink; tendency toward hyperactivity.

desc: Cultivated liver cells that filter and neutralize ingested or bloodborne toxins and drugs.
effect: 0.2 BI and 24,000¥ per level (max level = unaugmented Body).
Reduces blood-toxin attack Power by 1 per 2 levels.

desc: An enhanced spleen producing aggressive white cells that fight off disease and infection.
effect: 0.2 BI and 24,000¥ per level (max level = unaugmented Body).
+1 die to Resistance Tests vs disease / allergens per level.
Reduces microbiological attack Power by 1 per 2 levels.

desc: Added brain tissue that raises Intelligence and improves task processing.
effect: L1 0.4 BI / 50,000¥ — +1 Intelligence.
L2 0.8 BI / 110,000¥ — +2 Intelligence, +1 Task Pool.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass pain inhibitors so injury up to a set level doesn't impair you.
effect: 0.2 BI and 25,000¥ per level.
Ignore wound penalties up to the compensator's level (Physical and Stun).
Damage beyond that level counts from the compensator level upward.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass pain inhibitors so injury up to a set level doesn't impair you.
effect: 0.2 BI and 50,000¥ per level.
Ignore wound penalties up to the compensator's level (Physical and Stun).
Damage beyond that level counts from the compensator level upward.

desc: Nerve fibers that bypass pain inhibitors so injury up to a set level doesn't impair you.
effect: 0.2 BI and 100,000¥ per level.
Ignore wound penalties up to the compensator's level (Physical and Stun).
Damage beyond that level counts from the compensator level upward.

desc: Grafted gray matter on the hippocampus that boosts short- and long-term memory.
effect: 0.2 BI and 15,000¥ per level (max level = unaugmented Body).
+1 die per 2 levels to Knowledge / Language Success Tests.
-1 TN per level to 'do I recall this?' Intelligence tests.

desc: Nerve tissue that filters pain so the user ignores all wound penalties — at a cognitive cost.
effect: +1 Willpower, -1 Intelligence.
Ignores ALL wound modifiers while active; +4 TN to tactile Perception.
User is unaware of their own injuries until incapacitated.

desc: Spinal nerve clusters that record one learned skill, permanently improving its execution.
effect: 0.1 BI / 10,000¥ — +1 to one Concentration skill.
Permanent, non-cumulative, incompatible with skillwires.

desc: Spinal nerve clusters that record one learned skill, permanently improving its execution.
effect: 0.25 BI / 25,000¥ — +1 to one General skill.
Permanent, non-cumulative, incompatible with skillwires.

desc: Lengthened neural pathways that speed nerve signals to raise Initiative — the bioware reaction enhancer.
effect: L1 0.3 BI / 75,000¥ — +1D6 Initiative.
L2 1.6 BI / 200,000¥ — +2D6 Initiative.
Stacks with Wired or Boosted Reflexes; gives no benefit to deckers / riggers.

desc: Thalamic receptors that release endorphins to soften the shock of a fresh injury.
effect: On taking physical damage, reduce that wound's Damage Level by 1.
+2 TN to others' attempts to cause you pain.
Cannot be combined with a Damage Compensator.

desc: A rebuilt kidney that filters waste and toxins far more effectively.
effect: +1 to Body for tests resisting toxins and pathogens.
Reduces blood-vectored toxin attack Power by 1.

desc: Augmented diaphragm and lung capacity that extends how long you can hold your breath.
effect: L1 0.2 BI / 8,000¥ — +45s breath-hold.
L3 0.4 BI / 25,000¥ — +135s (with a small stamina penalty).

desc: A neck sac that lets the user breathe out a single chosen toxin at a nearby target.
effect: 30,000¥ plus 100× the cost of one dose of the chosen toxin.
Quickness Test to hit; +1 TN per half-meter (max range = half unaugmented Body in meters).
Double your Body Rating to resist your own toxin.

desc: Filters in the upper trachea that neutralize airborne and gaseous attacks.
effect: 0.2 BI and 30,000¥ per level (max Rating = unaugmented Body).
Reduces gas / airborne attack Power by half the filter level (round down).

desc: Joint and tendon reworking giving extreme fluidity of movement.
effect: +1 Reaction.
+1 die to Active-Skill Success Tests for motion-intensive skills (e.g. Athletics).
No benefit to pure rigging or decking.

desc: Biological replacement of natural muscle with stronger woven fibers — the bioware muscle replacement.
effect: 0.8 BI and 45,000¥ per level (max level 4).
+1 Quickness and +1 Strength per level.
Helps rigging/decking only for lifting and carrying.
